text: Acceptance design: semantic contracts pin SHA-256, hemisphere identity, 10,242 vertices and 20,480 faces per fsaverage5 pial GIFTI; oracle contract compares native pixels and picking to the shared CPU rasterizer; metamorphic/adversarial checks reject horizontal/vertical flips, hemisphere swaps, and field-length mismatch; performance contract records parse/compile/upload/first-frame and verifies camera-only updates perform zero geometry/layer uploads. Candidate corpus remains external until data-specific redistribution terms are established.
